starts.name: Sandshi
starts.note: Base village listed by Trekshitiz (as Sandashi). The final climb to the cave is exposed; go with someone who knows the route.

starts.name: Lohagadwadi
starts.note: Road reaches this hamlet below the fort; most walkers start here.

starts.name: Malavli
starts.note: Railway station for local trains; walk via Bhaje to Lohagadwadi.

starts.name: Malavli
starts.note: Railway station; the trail goes via Bhaje village.

starts.name: Gunjavane
starts.note: Common route to Padmavati Machi; Maharashtra Tourism describes it as moderate.

starts.name: Pali
starts.note: Route to Sanjivani Machi; Maharashtra Tourism describes this option as more challenging.

starts.name: Velhe
starts.note: Maharashtra Tourism describes the main trail from Velhe.

starts.name: Ratanwadi
starts.note: Common start near the Amruteshwar temple.

starts.name: Prabalgad Machi
starts.note: Reached from Thakurwadi; the climb has exposed rock-cut steps.

starts.name: Rajmachi village
starts.note: Reached by the long jeep track from Lonavala, or by the climb from Kondivade.

starts.name: Waghambe
starts.note: Common route from the Salota side.

starts.name: Bari
starts.note: Base village identified by Maharashtra Tourism for the main route.
